name: Dr. Ananthen K S
qualifications: MBBS, DCH, MD (Paediatrics), Fellowship in Paediatric Cardiology, PGDMLE
earlierStart: Dr. Ananthen Killikulangara Sadanandan completed his M.B.B.S in 1998
fullBio:
Dr. Ananthen Killikulangara Sadanandan completed his MBBS in 1998 at Government Medical College, Thrissur, and his DCH (2002) and MD in Paediatrics (2003) at Government Medical College, Alappuzha. He completed a Fellowship in Paediatric Cardiology at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences, Kochi, in 2004, and holds a Postgraduate Diploma in Medical Law & Ethics (PGDMLE) from the National Law School of India University, Bangalore.

From 2005 to 2007 he worked in the Department of Neonatology at MOSC Medical College, Kolenchery, Kerala. He then underwent advanced training in neonatology in Australia, where he worked for five years in some of the best neonatal centres, including Monash Medical Centre, Melbourne; the Royal Hospital for Women, Sydney; and Liverpool Hospital, Sydney.

During his work overseas he was exposed to the latest advances in neonatal care, including the resuscitation, stabilisation and ongoing care of extremely premature babies. He was also part of the renowned Neonatal and Paediatric Emergency Transport Service (NETS), Westmead, Sydney, and has performed almost a hundred retrievals of sick infants and children by road, rotor-wing and fixed-wing transport.

His other interests include teaching and research. He was a Conjoint Lecturer at the University of New South Wales, Sydney, has three publications to his name and has delivered many presentations in India and abroad.

He is presently Chief Consultant and Head of the Department of Paediatrics and Neonatology at Kinder Women’s Hospital & Fertility Centre, Cherthala.

### Areas of interest

- Neonatology
- High-risk preterm care
- Teaching & research
